mainEntity.name: Can the exterior and interior of a pre-engineered metal home be customized?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can customize both the interior and exterior of a metal home to look indistinguishable from a conventional luxury residence. Steel clear-span frames carry roof loads directly to the exterior foundation, allowing you to position interior partition walls anywhere without load-bearing constraints. For the exterior, you are not limited to ribbed vertical steel panels; your contractor can integrate stucco, stone wainscoting, wood siding accents, and custom covered porches. This flexibility makes it easy to satisfy neighborhood aesthetics while maintaining the structural longevity of a steel frame.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. The exterior can incorporate stucco, stone, and traditional siding, while the interior clear-span structure allows completely custom, non-load-bearing room layouts.
